positive_terms: Indication of subsidiary undertakings included in consolidation that are exempted from individual or consolidated sustainability reporting
纳入合并但豁免独立披露的子公司

Indication of subsidiary undertakings included in consolidation that are exempted from individual or consolidated sustainability reporting。纳入合并但豁免独立披露的子公司。集团、独立主体及上下游披露范围分别记录；可持续与财务合并边界一致必须由报告明确声明，不能从名称或文件年推定。
